implementation.authority: ReferenceOrganizationCatalog.decide under the exclusive policy guard; events via PolicySql.commit
implementation.durability: Receipts state LocalOnly/Pending/Durable as recorded; no independent-durability claim beyond O03.6

acceptance.criterion: Support authorized lab/project creation, membership updates, dataset placement and stewardship transfer with clear public errors and audit records.
acceptance.evidence: OrganizationHttpSuite (9 tests, PostgreSQL): lab admins create projects and manage memberships; project stewards manage participations; contributors create ExplicitOnly datasets they steward; stewards appoint, end and transfer stewardship and confirm inheritance against the reviewed preview digest; dataset moves need the dataset, source and destination stewards. Every mutation appends its event (kinds verified by ServicePrivilegesSuite) and returns a receipt. Errors: 428 missing preconditions, 409 stale/reused/closed/last-steward, uniform 404 without authority, 400 invalid input (e.g. unknown custodian).

acceptance.criterion: Enforce current authority and expected generations on every mutation; retries cannot duplicate membership or perform a second transfer.
acceptance.evidence: Stale generations return 409; identical retries return the original receipt and server-minted IDs (project, dataset); a retry is reauthorized first, so a former steward's transfer retry is denied while the transfer happened once; two concurrent transfers of one stewardship leave exactly one active steward.

acceptance.criterion: A trusted bootstrap can establish the first steward; ordinary users cannot exploit that path, remove the last steward silently or grant themselves wider access.
acceptance.evidence: Bootstrap remains the reviewed operator migration. Lab creation, principal disablement and stewardship recovery require the operator connection and bootstrap operator principal; the runtime login is refused by application check and row security (forged CreateLab/OrganizationGenesis/DisablePrincipal events fail with 42501). Ending the last eligible steward is 409; a project steward cannot appoint themselves dataset steward or switch inheritance on an ExplicitOnly dataset; recovery is refused while an eligible steward exists.

commands: bash scripts/check-postgres.sh (sbt check, complete integration project 333/333, crash/retry and coordinated restore demonstrations)

results.integration: 333/333 (complete integration project, including OrganizationHttpSuite 9/9 and ServicePrivilegesSuite 6/6)

limitations: Local engineering evidence; no institutional reviewer acceptance.
Custody transfer (ADR 001 Change custody) is not implemented; new custodians remain an operator decision.
Organization directories and pagination are F05.1; this task supplies single-resource reads only.
No 403 is used for authorized readers denied a known action; every denial is the uniform 404 (ADR permits 403, does not require it).
Organization state is still loaded in full per command (H04 scale qualification).
The root sbt aggregate excludes the integration project; integration evidence comes from scripts/check-postgres.sh.
